title: mcmero/duplex-seq-pipeline pipeline parameters
description: Duplex sequencing (NanoSeq) analysis pipeline: UMI extraction, alignment, duplex consensus calling, QC and variant calling

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a comma-separated samplesheet (columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, optional read_structure and umi_file).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. Use an absolute path for cloud storage.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to the output directory.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Reference genome. Missing indexes are built by the pipeline.

fasta.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file.

fasta_fai.description: Optional samtools faidx index of the FASTA. Built when not provided.

dict.description: Optional Picard sequence dictionary of the FASTA. Built when not provided.

bwa.description: Optional directory containing the bwa index of the FASTA (files named after the FASTA). Built when not provided.

umi_options.title: UMI options
umi_options.description: UMI extraction (fgbio ExtractUmisFromBam) and correction (fgbio CorrectUmis).

read_structure.description: Read structure for each strand, e.g. 3M2S146T = 3 UMI bases, 2 skipped, 146 template bases. Can be overridden per sample in the samplesheet.

molecular_index_tags.description: SAM tags in which to store the molecular indices (ExtractUmisFromBam --molecular-index-tags).

single_tag.description: Single tag into which to concatenate all molecular indices (ExtractUmisFromBam --single-tag).

umis.description: File of known UMI sequences, one per line, used to correct UMIs. Leave unset to skip correction. Can be overridden per sample in the samplesheet.

max_mismatches.description: Maximum number of UMI mismatches (used only if correcting UMIs).

min_distance.description: Minimum distance in mismatches to the next best UMI (used only if correcting UMIs).

consensus_options.title: Consensus calling options
consensus_options.description: Duplex consensus calling and filtering (fgbio GroupReadsByUmi, CallDuplexConsensusReads, FilterConsensusReads).

min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality used by GroupReadsByUmi (--min-map-q).

min_input_baseq.description: Minimum input base quality used by CallDuplexConsensusReads (--min-input-base-quality).

error_rate_pre_umi.description: Phred-scaled error rate for an error prior to the UMIs being integrated (CallDuplexConsensusReads --error-rate-pre-umi).

error_rate_post_umi.description: Phred-scaled error rate for an error after the UMIs have been integrated (CallDuplexConsensusReads --error-rate-post-umi).

min_reads.description: Minimum number of reads supporting a consensus base/read (FilterConsensusReads --min-reads): total, then each strand.

max_read_error_rate.description: Maximum raw-read error rate across the entire consensus read (FilterConsensusReads --max-read-error-rate).

max_base_error_rate.description: Maximum error rate for a single consensus base (FilterConsensusReads --max-base-error-rate).

min_base_quality.description: Mask consensus bases with quality below this threshold (FilterConsensusReads --min-base-quality).

max_no_call_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of no-calls in the read after filtering (FilterConsensusReads --max-no-call-fraction).

fastq_screen_config.description: FastQ Screen configuration file. FastQ Screen is skipped when unset.

run_qualimap.description: Run Qualimap BAM QC on the mapped and consensus BAMs (resource-intensive).

duplex_metrics.description: Metrics to calculate with calc-duplex-metrics: comma-separated individual metrics (frac_singletons, efficiency, drop_out_rate) and/or groups (gc, family).

target_bed.description: BED file of target regions for calculating the on-target rate in capture experiments. Not passed to calc-duplex-metrics when unset.

output_read_info.description: Write read_info files; when true calc-duplex-metrics uses them as input instead of reading the BAM.

sort_mem.description: Memory for sort in calc-duplex-metrics BAM mode (--sort_mem).

bam_chunk_size.description: BAM records per streaming chunk in calc-duplex-metrics BAM mode (--bam_chunk_size).

variant_caller.description: Variant caller: nvc (naive variant caller) or varscan.

min_coverage.description: Minimum duplex coverage to call a variant.

min_reads2.description: Minimum supporting duplex reads to call a variant.

min_vaf.description: Minimum duplex VAF to call a variant.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
